request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, for onward project-specific administration; vendor identified as TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Pallas by TxPipe maintenance and enhancement for Year 2 over a 12-month period, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates re-implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
Pallas is used as shared infrastructure by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The proposal states that Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with links to GitHub and crates.io.
The requested work is organized into essential maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting and audited-results materials.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

Audit and oversight costs are said to be included in the proposal overhead, with independent oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, named oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Year 2 maintenance grant for Pallas by TxPipe, administered by Intersect through smart contracts with oversight, and frames Pallas as core open-source Rust infrastructure with measurable public repository and package adoption.
